text:
maya (Design): quick thread on the model catalog compare prototypes — flagged a few UX bits after the demo: row height, badge density, filter persistence, and how pinning is surfaced. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compare-v4

ryan (PM): thanks — top priorities: make scanning faster for infra/pm folks and avoid accidental pinning on prod routes. also keep keyboard-first accessibility in mind.

kai (Eng): implementation note: we render huge lists with windowing. two-line compact rows are doable but we need stable heights. variable-height rows hurt virtualization perf. prefer fixed 56px row height for compact mode.

maya (Design): proposal A: 56px fixed row, left area: model name + version pill (small), right area: three micro-metrics inline (p95, tokens/sec, est cost) as small chips with color accent. hover shows expanded details. Proposal B: 72px rows with stacked badges which increases visual separation but reduces density. Thoughts? :pushpin:

lex (Product): I'm leaning A for dense lists; B for shortlists or when people are comparing fewer models. Could we surface a density toggle? default to compact for catalog listing, expanded for compare view?

taylor (Research): metrics usability: numeric p95 is useful but many users prefer qualitative labels for a quick pass. Suggest numeric primary + tiny qualitative label (e.g., "95ms • fast") where the label color maps to banding. That keeps precision and glanceability.

kai (Eng): agree numeric + small qualitative text is fine. chips should be simple spans to avoid extra DOM. cost estimate calculation: we need to derive from token profile; I can add a lightweight estimator in the backend and return a precomputed string like "$0.02 /1k".

maya (Design): pin affordance: current mock has a pin in the overflow menu and a small icon on hover. two concerns: discoverability and accidental clicks. idea: show a subtle inline lock icon next to the version pill only on hover/focus; persistent when pinned. keyboard shortcut: "P" toggles pin for focused row + show toast.

ryan (PM): product rule: pinning a model on a prod route requires a confirmation modal with the wording: "Pinning will freeze model updates on this route. Confirm to proceed." For non-prod routes no modal.

kai (Eng): implementation: inline lock icon is trivial. modal for prod check needs route context from the UI. agree on toast on toggle. Also will add an event: analytics.track("pin_toggled", {route_env, model_version, pinned}).

maya (Design): accessibility note: ensure the lock icon has accessible name and a 24px target min. visual state change should not rely on color only.

 a11y-bot: accessibility recommendations: 1) lock button must have aria-pressed and an aria-label like "Pin model version v2.1 to route"; 2) ensure 4.5:1 contrast for focus stroke on the chip; 3) add sr-only status region updates when pin state changes ("Version v2.1 pinned to route").

lex (Product): filter persistence: ask was whether to persist filters per-user or per-route. my suggestion: remember last-used filters per-user (local storage) and allow explicit "Save as preset for route" which stores server-side and visible to route collaborators.

taylor (Research): also add a tiny UI hint when filters auto-restore: "Restored your last filters" with option "Always use this for this route" to convert to preset. Quick A/B test: measure time to find target model with/without presets.

kai (Eng): backend work: add /api/user/presets and /api/route/:id/presets endpoints. client chore: merge local last-used with server presets and prefer explicit route presets if present. ETA: 3-4 dev days with tests.

maya (Design): small copy tweaks: change tooltip text for pin to "Pin this model version to the route (prevents automatic model updates)" and change badge hover detail header to "Performance snapshot". Also use sentence case for micro-chips.

lex (Product): action items: maya 1 push updated mocks for compact + expanded with inline lock and numeric+qualitative chips; kai 1 spike endpoints and give exact dev ETA; taylor 1 draft A/B eval plan for micro-badges + presets; i'll update the product PRD with pin confirmation rules. sync Thursday 9:30am. :spiral_calendar:

maya (Design): noted. leaving a quick prototype in figma with keyboard flows + focus states. thanks everyone! :coffee:
